title: Kavach combined-receipts document
description: The full document written by validate_replay_receipts.py's combined_summary() (or validate_manifest() standalone) — the deterministic handoff contract from kavach-diagnose to kavach-repair. Traced directly from that script's actual output, not the per-worker receipt shape described in the live-replay-diagnosis skill's Phase 3 (which has productBugGate/productBugArtifacts booleans that are checked at production time but never copied forward into this merged document — only the resulting gateProblems list is).

manifest.description: Present instead of triageManifest/replayManifest when validate_manifest() ran standalone (no --triage-manifest).

affectedScenarios.description: Only present when this row came from a real worker receipt (not a missing-receipt fallback row).

distinctIssueCount.description: Only present when this row came from a real worker receipt.

verdict.description: Machine-format verdict, post-gate-validation (may differ from originalVerdict if a gate check downgraded it).

originalVerdict.description: The verdict the diagnosing worker originally claimed, before validate_receipt()'s gate checks. Only present when this row came from a real worker receipt.

reportVerdict.description: Human-readable label for the verdict report table, e.g. 'Script Issue — Fix Proposed'.

gateProblems.description: Plain-English reasons validate_receipt() downgraded this row's originally-claimed verdict, if any. Empty for a row whose verdict was never downgraded.

evidence.description: Concrete observed evidence (DOM excerpts, count()/evaluate() outputs, error text).

recommendedAction.description: Free-text description of the proposed fix. Only present when this row came from a real worker receipt. There is no structured fixSuggestion object by design — kavach-repair derives targetFile/targetLine/the concrete patch from this text plus the matching fix-pattern file, never from recommendedAction text alone without a pattern-file match.

analysisTier.description: Whether this row's evidence came from an actual live browser (tier2_live_replay) or a cheaper static/cached tier. Only present when this document came from combined_summary() (i.e. validate_replay_receipts.py was invoked with --triage-manifest, which is how the real pipeline always calls it).

blockedReason.description: Set only on rows affected by a --blocked-reason run (live replay was interrupted).

gateProblems.description: A row can only carry verdict confirmed_product_bug if validate_receipt() found zero gate problems — any problem downgrades it to suspected_product_bug. A non-empty gateProblems here means the document was hand-edited or the producer's own invariant was violated.
